about: What this setup relies on in the design-assembly plugin, read from the plugin's own files at the version below. host-strings.json beside this file is a byte copy of the plugin's references/host-strings.json at that version. Tests in tests/seams.sh (51f to 51k) pin this side against these; nothing here runs the plugin. To read a newer version: copy the plugin's references/host-strings.json over the one here, read the contract's From birth column and the adopt skill again, and change version and read.
from: plugins/design-assembly/references/contract.md, section From birth and the From birth column
plugins/design-assembly/skills/adopt/SKILL.md, sections When a repository has only just been given its floor and 2. Preview

0.means: the ledgers are laid and nothing waits on a person

1.means: the ledgers are laid and answers wait on a person, on the waiting list the plugin's status prints

2.means: a wrong call, or a repository the plugin cannot read

adopt_starter.own_values: a repository with values of its own (a primary colour with a hue of its own, or values adopted before) gets the ledgers all the same and ends with 0 or 1; every value is recorded as the repository's, and the plugin's status says its guide is not for that repository
